lines: Read by claude (claude-opus-5-5): {"kind":"bank_detail_change_request","personName":"Maria Garcia","urgent":true,"includesNewAccountDetails":true}
Claude's summary: An email claiming to be from Maria Garcia asks for her pay to be sent today to a new CLABE account because her old account was closed.
Red flags: urgent same-day request; sent from personal gmail address; claims old account was closed; new CLABE provided in email; no verification offered
Matched to Maria Garcia (Northwind Labs). The account number in the email is not used.
Hold Maria Garcia: bank-detail change requested on payday; request came by email, not the verified portal.
Everyone else at Northwind Labs is still paid (11 payouts).
Verification request goes to the contact on file, not to maria.garcia.payments@gmail.com.

Note for the ops lead, by claude (claude-opus-5-5): The payroll agent placed a fraud hold on Maria Garcia's MXN 45,000.00 payout from Northwind Labs after an email from maria.garcia.payments@gmail.com at 04:20 asked to pay a new account today. The agent stopped because the bank-detail change was requested on payday and came by email rather than through the verified portal. Call Maria Garcia on the phone number on file; if the account is unchanged, approve paying the account ending 7771 on file, and never pay the account in the email.

events.title: Approval: instant advance for Andrea Cruz on Metal testnet
lines: Andrea Cruz opted in to instant advances on 2026-10-02 through the verified portal, to 0xA3aE…31DF. Contoso Health caps an advance at USD 50.00.
Approval requested: advance 50.00 USDZ from Contoso Health's Metal account 0xd97e…b34B to Andrea Cruz. Bound to SHA-256 c90189138de2…
Approved by ops-lead@platform.example (scripted approver).
Mandate on Contoso Health's Metal account, enforced on chain: pays only Andrea Cruz, at most 50.00 USDZ per payment and 50.00 USDZ in total (spent 0.00 USDZ).
Probe, bypassing our policy code: 50.00 USDZ to 0x0000…dEaD, an address not on the mandate. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_payee_not_listed (the payee is not one the mandate allows)
Probe, bypassing our policy code: 50.01 USDZ to Andrea Cruz, one cent over the cap. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_cap_exceeded (the amount is above the mandate's per-payment cap)
Paid 50.00 USDZ to Andrea Cruz on Metal testnet: transaction 0xbea5…156e https://testnet.metalntwx.com/tx/0xbea56d14c2b9f86857b53737f77a56837a45b2a3059a8251608cce0282f7156e
Same pull again, same payment id: already paid, nothing sent.
Probe, bypassing our policy code: another 50.00 USDZ to Andrea Cruz under a new payment id. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_budget_spent (the amount would take the mandate past its budget)
Verified from the chain alone (mandate verify): yes, 1 payment under this mandate.
The remaining PHP 256,852.54 goes in the next Philippine LOCAL window; Andrea Cruz is told now.
